There's no need to spend multiple hundreds of dollars on a quality pair of noise canceling headphones. For Black Friday, Amazon is offering the tried-and-true Bose QuietComfort wireless noise canceling headphones for a jaw-droppingly low price of $124.88 with free delivery. This is by far the lowest price I've seen for a brand new pair (by nearly 25%!). The only caveat? This price is only available in the "Petal Pink" color way, which is admittedly a very nice shade of pink.

Black Friday Deal: Bose QuietComfort Headphones for $124.88

The rest of the colors start at $169

The QuietComfort is Bose's best selling noise canceling headphone. The headset is well-regarded for its excellent audio quality, noise canceling performance, and all-day comfort. The QuietComfort also lasts up to 30 hours, and charging for just 15 minutes over USB-C will give you several hours of additional playtime.

The design hasn't changed much from its previous iteration (QuietComfort 45), but why fix what isn't broken? At a price point of under $150, it's easily one of the best noise canceling headphones - if not the best - in its class. Compare that to the Bose QuietComfort Ultra, which costs nearly twice as much.

Upgrade to the 2nd gen model for $75 more

Bose quietly released a newer second generation update in August of 2026. It's also on sale for $199, which is the lowest price since launch. For an extra $30 more, you get a whole host of welcome upgrades, including Bose TrueSpatial audio, lossless sound, Cinema mode, improved Aware mode, and redesigned plusher headband that's designed to be more comfortable during extended use.
